messages:
Maria K.: quick heads-up — ran a focused bring-up of delta13b-int6 on the SDG product slice (~10k convs). Quick summary below, looking for GTN/product recs and rollout plan.

Kevin L.: thanks — paste the microbench results?

Maria K.: ```
model: delta13b-int6
slice: SDG-prod-sample (~10k convs)
avg tokens/req: 120
latency p95: 210ms
latency p99: 780ms
QPS (single shard): 18
cost per 1M tokens (hosted): $12.4
baseline (delta13b-int8) cost per 1M: $17.8  (-30% cost)
quality (vs int8 baseline):
  - QA exact match: 87.6 -> 85.4  (-2.2)
  - Summarization Rouge-L: 41.2 -> 40.6  (-0.6)
  - Hallucination heuristic (entity halluc): 3.1% -> 5.0% (+1.9)
prompt sensitivity (edge cases): +0.8% variance
notes: priming stability looked ok on medium-length contexts; longform summmary tail shows slight degradation.
```

Sachin P.: rough translation to user impact — that ~2.2pt EM drop maps to ~1-1.5% lower helpfulness metric on SDG prompts, but saves ~30% unit cost.

Olivia R.: product POV: 1-1.5% hit in helpfulness is borderline for GTN feature — could be acceptable if rollback/fallback is fast and metrics are instrumented. Need mitigation plan.

Kevin L.: ops note — p99 increase to 780ms matters for low-latency routes. If we enable smaller batch sizes for low-latency traffic and keep batching for background, we can recover tail. Also KV cache hit rate increases are our biggest wins here.

Maria K.: mitigation ideas:
- mixed fleet routing (int6 for bulk, int8 for safety -> fallback based on safety score)
- prefix/KV caching for repeated prompts (should cut token cost and p95)
- holdback canary (10-25%) with event-level logging for hallucination signals
- tune quantization profile (re-run with more calibration for a subset)

Olivia R.: proposed rollout plan:
1) Canary: 20% traffic for 2 weeks; collect helpfulness, CTR, hallucination signal, latency tails.
2) Mixed routing: 70% int6 / 30% int8 for production after canary if no regression >1% helpfulness.
3) Safety rule: if hallucination signal spikes >+1.5pp or helpfulness drops >1.2pp for 48h, auto-fallback to 100% int8.

Kevin L.: config notes to set with infra:
- route_tag: sdg-mixed-int6-v1
- fallback_score_threshold: 0.70
- batch_size_lowlatency: 1-4
- enable_prefix_cache: true

Maria K.: sample eval snippet (for the telemetry team)
```
# eval slice: sdg_critical_examples
metrics = run_eval(model='delta13b-int6', dataset='sdg_critical', seeds=42)
# look at EM, halluc_rate, latency distribution
```

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary: delta13b-int6 -> traffic split 20% on 2025-05-12 09:00 UTC (owner: Maria K.) :rocket:

Sachin P.: action items:
- Maria K.: push eval config & event logging (helpfulness, halluc markers) — due EOD tomorrow
- Kevin L.: set routing flags, batch low-latency override, prefix cache rollout (infra change window)
- Olivia R.: confirm product KPIs and signoff for 20% canary by EOD
- I (Sachin) will run longer priming sweeps and calibration attempt for int6 quant profile

Olivia R.: leaning +1 to try the canary with those safety gates. please keep me looped on early telemetry. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
